svg.title: Incident Zero architecture
svg.text: Incident Zero
AI on-call engineer for the OpenTelemetry Demo · detect → investigate → diagnose → audit → plan → approve → act → verify → report

Nine agents in one process; every write goes through a separate Action API. Telemetry says what is broken, knowledge says how to fix it, a human approves the exact plan, and the Verifier proves it worked.
OpenTelemetry Demo
28 containers · Docker Compose · 8 GB
+ otel-collector (span_metrics connector) · prometheus · jaeger · opensearch · grafana · opamp
Telemetry backends
read only
Prometheus span metrics (calls, duration) · docker_stats CPU/mem
Jaeger v2 traces via /api/v3 (OTLP JSON → spans)
OpenSearch service logs (flat dotted keys)
Docker Engine state, restarts, OOM, health, limits
Practice harness
off in eval mode · agents cannot import it
Fault injector flags · stop · pause · kill loop · CPU/memory
limits · netem delay/loss · disconnect · real user traffic · Locust flood
Hidden truth + Judge /10: detect 1 · component 3 · category 1 ·
audit 2 · exact fix executed 2 · recovery verified 1
Campaign settle → inject → approve as test operator → verify →
revert → score · 20 tune/holdout + 9 blind scenarios
OTLP
inject faults (Docker, flag file, Locust) · revert after every incident closes
Agent process
incident_zero up · Python · no Docker write client (import test)
PromQL · Jaeger v3 · OpenSearch query · docker inspect

HTTP
State
.incident_zero/ (JSON files, no database)
incidents + append-only evidence ledger (E<n>)
event bus → Server-Sent Events stream to the UI
memory.jsonl · verified outcomes per incident
reports (JSON + Markdown) · state.json (mode)
practice runs · campaign results + evaluation note
HTTP + bearer token
Action API
separate process · :8701 · owns every write
restart_service
toggle_feature_flag
throttle_load_generator
scale_service (k8s only)
dry-run preview
rollback by execution id
Docker SDK (restart) · flag file written in place (flagd watches the bind mount)
Locust /swarm (users) · kill switch: refuses every call, rolls back recent actions
catalog of allowed actions + parameter schemas is served to the Planner
restart · toggle flag · throttle load
Safety controls
• Dry run at start; going live is a deliberate, logged switch
• Kill switch (UI · API · CLI · STOP file): freeze + roll back
• Approval bound to the plan's SHA-256: any edit voids it
• Quotes checked verbatim: no invented evidence or reasons
• Flag settings redacted from telemetry; flagd never read
• Agents have no Docker write client (import test)
Detection and verification math
rate window 2m (span metrics land ~1/min) · per-operation window 5m
baseline: learned from quiet ticks, else same query 10 min ago
error ratio ≥ 5% · p95 > max(800 ms, factor × baseline)
traffic: entry rps > 3× baseline, or Locust users > 3× normal (5)
CPU ≥ 80% of a core and ≥ 3× its own baseline
memory evidence only ≥ own baseline + 8 pts (or OOM kill)
symptoms of a diagnosed root cause join it, held 300 s after it resolves
